Which color looks best on Karen?

Two photos at a time — pick whichever one her face looks better in — not which color you prefer. Which one makes her look well rather than washed out and tired?

Some pairs are close. Pick a side anyway — a faint lean tells us more than a tie. “Both” and “neither” are there when you truly need them — they just give us less to work with, so reach for them last.

So look at her, not the garment:

  • Does her skin look clear and even, or does redness and blotchiness show more?
  • Does she look rested, or tired — shadows, lines around nose and mouth?
  • Do you see her first, or do you see the garment first?

One thing that will throw you. She looks yellower or greyer in some photos and you will want to write it off as bad lighting. Please don’t — we measured the light in every frame and it does not explain it. That is the garment doing it, and it is the whole thing we are looking for.

No expertise needed and there’s no right answer — go on instinct and go fast. Stop whenever you like; 62 matchups covers the full set.

Before you start — only if it’s easy.

This one is about color, so screens matter a little:

  • Use a laptop rather than a phone, if one is handy
  • Turn off dark mode, and Night Shift or True Tone if your screen has it
  • Sit somewhere with ordinary light, not a dark room

If none of that is convenient, go ahead anyway — your answers still count.
